cases.source_utf8:
SELECT 1 AS anchor;
MERGE INTO dbo.t AS tgt
USING dbo.s AS src ON tgt.id = src.id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.v = src.v
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (id, v) VALUES (src.id, src.v)
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN DELETE
OUTPUT $action, inserted.id;
